description: Come back to the room one sense at a time. Nothing needs to be typed or remembered.
finish_line_one: You came back to the room.
finish_line_two: That is enough for right now.

steps.label: Things you can see
steps.hint: Look around slowly. Small, ordinary details count.

steps.label: Things you can feel
steps.hint: Notice clothing, the chair, or your feet against the floor.

steps.label: Things you can hear
steps.hint: Listen for sounds both close to you and farther away.

steps.label: Things you can smell
steps.hint: If nothing stands out, remember two familiar smells.

steps.label: Thing you can taste
steps.hint: Notice what is already there, or remember a familiar taste.
